answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fakes. To claim a slot in the grove, an agent posts a deposit worth twice its expected 30-day earnings and cracks a walnut-hard puzzle for entry. Idle slots and misbehavior burn it; a clean shift returns it. Forging 100 slots costs 100 deposits and 100 puzzles, 200 times monthly earnings, while an honest agent risks one deposit. The summit council publishes every burn, so cheating is costly, honesty cheap.
